      "name": "docs",

      "evidence": "Changes to doc/release-notes-34534.md merely document the new RPC methods and startup option.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Release notes follow directly from the feature addition and do not constitute documentation as a primary change."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and adds `setprunelock` and `listprunelocks` in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp and src/rpc/client.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.62,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds missing RPC interfaces explicitly requested and tested by downstream tooling like electrs and external wallets to prevent blocks needed for rescanning from being pruned on pruned nodes. Reviewers confirmed that manual prune locks resolve a concrete integration gap for external software operating alongside pruned Bitcoin Core nodes."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "The functional test test/functional/rpc_prunelock.py and fuzz update test the new RPC feature rather than test framework infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Feature tests that pin the behavior of the new prune lock RPCs belong to the RPC area rather than general test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/init.cpp only to register the new `-prunelock` startup parameter.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adding command-line parameter handling specifically for prune locks is tied to that feature rather than generic argument or initialization utility infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Alters block storage and pruning behavior in src/node/blockstorage.h and src/node/blockstorage.cpp to support user-managed prune locks.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Exposes BlockManager pruning locks to prevent deletion of block files required for wallet rescanning. The impact within validation is modest, reusing existing prune lock mechanisms without altering core block-connection or validation invariants."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 0,

    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 2,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
